paragraphs: I'm Rohan, an aspiring data storyteller currently pursuing my Master of Business Analytics. I love turning messy data into clear, actionable insights and creating visualizations that actually make people say "aha!" When I'm not diving into datasets, you'll find me exploring new analytical tools and techniques, always looking for better ways to communicate through data.

Built a strong foundation in business and analytics at Goldman Sachs, where I developed sharp analytical skills and crucial business acumen while navigating a fast-paced financial services environment.
I'm currently deepening my analytical capabilities through the Master of Business Analytics (MBAN) program. My focus is on data visualization, statistical modeling, and business intelligence.
I'm eager to apply my data analytics and visualization skills to tackle complex business challenges and spearhead truly data-informed decision-making.
